verdict.rationale: Granola explicitly claims to work with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and other apps, and records via computer audio rather than a bot joining the call, directly addressing the 'recording where I want it' preference. Community evidence corroborates real-world reliability (battery/performance) and PM usage, though no independent side-by-side accuracy test across all three platforms is present. Missing for 10: independent verification of capture reliability across each specific platform (Zoom/Meet/Teams) and no mention of optional bot-based recording for cases where computer-audio capture isn't desired.
